objective: Preregister 18 candidates -- 12 PAIR_* candidates: rotation_cell's own cross-sectional momentum rotation mechanism (momentum_score by lookback, top_n=1 rank, absolute-momentum-vs-SHY filter, monthly rebalance), reused unedited at the degenerate menu size of 2, applied to six highly correlated ETF pairs (QQQ/SPY, SMH/QQQ, XLE/XOP, KRE/XLF, IWM/SPY, ARKK/QQQ) x lookback in {63,126} trading days -- plus 6 STATIC5050_* placebo candidates (one per pair): a fixed monthly-rebalanced 50/50 blend of the same two legs, no ranking, no cash filter, testing whether the *switching* mechanism itself adds value over simply holding both legs. PAIR candidates are tested against K1 (own date-neutral Sharpe >= 80% of S3's in both the anchor and stress windows, positive CAGR at 20bp) or K2 (a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both windows); any K1/K2/watch_recent pass is downgraded to 'not kept (no switching increment)' if it does not beat its own paired STATIC5050 control's judged Sharpe in every window it passed on. STATIC5050 candidates are controls only, never eligible for keep/strong/watch_recent. No backtest is run in this round; this manifest is the preregistration handed to the screening lane.

data_v1_sip_daily_etf_pair_switch_panel.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count
data_v1_sip_daily_etf_pair_switch_panel.source: alpaca SIP daily archive, fully adjusted closes
data_v1_sip_daily_etf_pair_switch_panel.confirmed_coverage: All 11 tickers (QQQ, SPY, SMH, XLE, XOP, KRE, XLF, IWM, ARKK, SHY, BIL) confirmed present in data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet from 2016-01-04 through 2026-09-28 (2,699 daily bars each), verified via a direct DuckDB query against the local panel on 2026-09-29; both the stress and anchor windows have full coverage, no short-sample caveat applies.

feature_v1_rotation_cell_pair_reuse.definition: Each PAIR candidate's weight vector is produced by scripts/screen_batches/h20260928_44_etf_pair_switch.py's make_pair_switch_fn(leg_a, leg_b, lookback) closure, which imports run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.momentum_score unedited (close.pct_change(lookback, fill_method=None)) and reproduces rotation_cell's top_n=1 rank plus absolute-momentum-vs-SHY filter at menu size 2, using only rows with index <= asof.

feature_v2_static_5050_blend.definition: Each STATIC5050 candidate's weight vector is produced by make_static5050_fn(leg_a, leg_b): a fixed {leg_a: 0.5, leg_b: 0.5} book whenever both legs have a valid close at asof, no ranking, no cash filter, using only rows with index <= asof.

label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill.definition: signal computed at session close; weights effective at the next session open (next_bar_open fill), matching the frozen S1/S2/S3 convention.

holdout_2026_contaminated: S3's own anchor window already covers part of this range; reported for reference only.
validation_v1_s3_stress_anchor_holdout20.rebalance_offset_robustness: Metrics are the median over monthly rebalance-day offsets 0-20 trading days.
validation_v1_s3_stress_anchor_holdout20.s3_reference_numbers: S3's own date-neutral Sharpe (median over 21 monthly offsets) is 1.49 in the anchor window and 0.81 in the stress window (owner-cited 2026-09-28, same reference used by every prior batch-screening round). K1's bars are 1.19 and 0.65 respectively.
validation_v1_s3_stress_anchor_holdout20.counter_evidence_rule: A PAIR candidate that clears K1 or K2 (or watch_recent) is downgraded to 'not kept (no switching increment)' if its judged net10 Sharpe in either window it passed on does not exceed its own paired STATIC5050 candidate's judged net10 Sharpe in that same window.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: This batch has 18 preregistered candidates (12 PAIR + 6 STATIC5050 placebo). DSR is reported for all 18 with n_trials=18, the size of this batch (conservative for both families).

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (median over monthly rebalance offsets) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH the anchor window (>=1.19) and the stress window (>=0.65), at 10bp per side, with positive CAGR at 20bp per side.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control (k solved so realized volatility matches) by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH the anchor and stress windows.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.19 (K1's anchor bar) but stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress).
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2 (PAIR candidates only; STATIC5050 candidates are controls, never eligible)
keep_rule.counter_evidence_downgrade: A PAIR candidate that would otherwise be kept, strong_keep, or watch_recent is downgraded to 'not kept (no switching increment)' if its judged net10 Sharpe in any window it passed on does not exceed its own paired STATIC5050 candidate's judged net10 Sharpe in that window.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 18 candidates; report all regardless of outcome; DSR with n_trials=18 for any PAIR candidate that passes K1 or K2.

parameters.name: QQQSPY relative-strength switch
parameters.rule: Rank {leg_a, leg_b} by momentum_score(close, str(lookback)) (close.pct_change(lookback), imported unedited from run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py); pick the higher-scoring leg; keep it only if its score beats SHY's own score over the same lookback (absolute-momentum filter, identical to rotation_cell); else hold 100% SHY via the screening lane's own remainder convention. Identical mechanism to rotation_cell at menu size 2 / top_n=1.
